description.en: Intended to report whether the active-event cutscene started with CMND_BTL_SET_ACTIVE_EVENT has finished playing. The native implementation always reports the same result regardless of the actual event state, so a `while (!CMND_BTL_IS_FINISH_ACTEV()) suspend();` wait loop never actually waits.
True on every valid call, regardless of whether the event has actually finished; null if the call was invalid.
